evidence_items.explanation: The broad benchmark documents a substantial gap between the evaluated language models and expert human raters. It supports the direction of Marcus's assessment, but does not evaluate every October system or practical general intelligence.

Gato's experiments span text, vision, and robotic control, so it is relevant counterevidence to treating all AI as confined to one specialty. The paper does not establish human-comparable general adaptability.

The benchmark compares selected language models with expert raters, not whole systems with ordinary human general intelligence.
